query: Please implement a fully automated system for Telegram and WhatsApp messaging. The system should have functionalities for creating bots, searching for specific phrases or text in Telegram groups, forwarding messages to WhatsApp, and making calls when search conditions are met. Users should be able to configure search conditions and forwarding rules, and view system logs and error reports. Initialize the background color with papaya whip and component color with peru.
